const { UserEye, loadConfig, AdaptiveExplorer } = require('usereye');
```

## The `issue` data model

Every finding in `result.json` — both the surfaced `issues` list and the
complete `issuesAll` list — carries the same shape. Automation built on top of
UserEye should read these fields and nothing else:

| Field                                         | Meaning                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `fingerprint`                                 | Stable identity of the finding across runs. `--compare` diffs on this.                  |
| `severity`                                    | `blocker` \| `critical` \| `major` \| `minor`. Drives the gates.                        |
| `confidence`                                  | `high` \| `medium` \| `low`. How sure the detector is.                                  |
| `kind`                                        | `defect` \| `risk` \| `signal` \| `opinion`. Opinions are recognized accepted patterns. |
| `triage` / `acceptedPattern`                  | `accepted-pattern` lane and the stable recognized-pattern ID; never a CI failure.       |
| `source`                                      | Which subsystem produced it (`axe`, `code-quality`, `explorer`, …).                     |
| `code`                                        | Machine-readable rule identifier within that source.                                    |
| `surfaced`                                    | Whether the finding passed `findings.minConfidence` into `issues`.                      |
| `title` / `expected` / `actual` / `technical` | Human-readable evidence.                                                                |

`issues` ⊆ `issuesAll`. Calming the report never destroys evidence: everything
observed stays in `issuesAll` with `surfaced: false`.

## Command audit

`result.commandAudit` lists every command that originated from the target
repository, whether it was `executed` or `blocked`, and why. `shell` is always
`false` — UserEye never invokes a shell.

export interface UserEyeOptions {
artifactDir?: string;
headless?: boolean;
browser?: 'chromium' | 'firefox' | 'webkit';
viewport?: { width: number; height: number };
locale?: string;
timezoneId?: string;
colorScheme?: 'light' | 'dark' | 'no-preference';
storageState?: string;
ignoreHTTPSErrors?: boolean;
acceptDownloads?: boolean;
userAgent?: string;
/** `'on-failure'` records a video but discards it when the run is clean. _/
recordVideo?: boolean | 'on-failure';
/_* Sink for the per-step `[PASS]/[WARN]/[FAIL]` lines (7.5.1). Default: console logger at `info`. _/
logger?: { info(message: string, fields?: Record<string, unknown>): void; step?(step: { number: number; name: string; status: string; durationMs: number }): void };
/_* Playwright trace policy (7.5.1). Engine default `'always'`; config/CLI default `'on-failure'`. _/
trace?: 'on-failure' | 'always' | 'never';
autoObserve?: 'off' | 'step' | 'failure';
visualAuditIssues?: boolean;
touchTarget?: number;
patienceEnabled?: boolean;
/_*
Language of findings, gaze narratives, user-plan steps, patience reasons and
generated reports. `'auto'` derives the pack from the run `locale`; unknown
tags fall back to `'en'`. Matches the shipped `locales/` packs.
/
reportLocale?: UserEyeReportLocale;
misclickDistance?: number;
/** Near-miss policy: `aggressive` (any side effect) or `stable-only` (hard signals only). _/
misclickPolicy?: 'stable-only' | 'aggressive';
/_* 200% zoom simulation strategy: `css` (default) | `viewport`. _/
zoomMode?: 'css' | 'viewport' | 'cdp';
/_* 7.3 opt-in user-journey battery (resilience + accessibility/device). Default off. _/
userJourney?: {
enabled?: boolean;
resilience?: { backgroundTab?: boolean; unsavedClose?: boolean; passwordRecovery?: boolean; lockout?: boolean; languageSwitch?: boolean };
a11y?: { permissions?: boolean; fastScroll?: boolean; keyboardShortcuts?: boolean; mobileLayout?: boolean; rightClick?: boolean; deadLinks?: boolean; textResize?: boolean; highContrast?: boolean; colorblind?: boolean };
lockoutAttempts?: number;
tempMail?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
hasLogin?: boolean | null;
};
/_* 7.4 opt-in browser-extension effect battery (resilience to popular extensions). Default off. _/
extensions?: {
enabled?: boolean;
categories?: { adBlocker?: boolean; darkReader?: boolean; passwordManager?: boolean; translator?: boolean; couponHelper?: boolean; fullPageCapture?: boolean; reactDevtools?: boolean; volumeBooster?: boolean };
};
/_* Timeout (ms) for `goto()` navigations. Default 15000. _/
navigationTimeoutMs?: number;
/_* Default timeout (ms) for `nextDialog()`. Default 5000. _/
dialogTimeoutMs?: number;
/_* Extra attempts for transient navigation failures. Default 1; 0 disables. _/
retries?: number;
/_* Base backoff (ms), grows linearly per attempt. Default 400. _/
retryBackoffMs?: number;
/_* Minimum delay (ms) between engine-issued actions. Default 0. */
minActionDelayMs?: number;
screenshotMaskSelectors?: string[];
}

/**
Aliases for the `findings` vocabulary, so both naming families resolve from the
package root: `UserEyeConfidence` / `UserEyeMisclickPolicy` are declared in
`./usereye-config` and re-exported by the `export *` above; the two aliases here
cover the issue-model names. Kept as type aliases (not new unions) so the
runtime classifier in `findings.js` remains the single source of truth.

#### `UserEyePatterns`

type UserEyePatterns = Record<
  | 'auth'
  | 'authPage'
  | 'setupPage'
  | 'dangerous'
  | 'write'
  | 'navigation'
  | 'utility'
  | 'skipLink'
  | 'copy'
  | 'errorPage'
  | 'emptyPage',
  RegExp
>;
```

Compiled pattern pack: one case-insensitive RegExp per category.
